messages.content:
You are an experienced UK building control surveyor. Answer the question about the work item
in the JSON state. Choose exactly one label:
- not_notifiable: No Building Regulations notice needed: not building work (reg 3), only Schedule 4 work, or an exempt building (reg 9, Schedule 2).
- competent_person_scheme: Notifiable work listed in Schedule 3: a registered competent person can self-certify it (reg 12(6)(a)); otherwise a building notice is needed.
- building_notice_or_full_plans: Building work not covered by Schedules 3 or 4: a building notice or a full plans application to building control (reg 12(2)).
- full_plans_required: Building work that must have a full plans application: the Fire Safety Order applies to the building (reg 12(3)), it fronts a private street (12(4)), or H4 applies (building over or near a sewer, 12(5)).
Reply with JSON only: {"label": "<one label>", "probabilities": {"<label>": <0..1>, ...}} with a
probability for every label, summing to 1.

Under the Building Regulations 2010 in England, which notification route applies to this work item if it is carried out on its own in the building described?

Major Installing external or internal wall insulation to more than 50% of the external wall area Replacement of windows and doors (1) f. Replacing less than or equal to 30% of the total existing windows or door units Minor g. Replacing more than 30% of the total existing windows or door units Major Draught-proofing (other than openings)(2) h. Replacing a loft hatch with a sealed/insulated unit Minor i. Sealing around structural or service penetrations through walls, floors or ceiling/roof Minor j. Sealing and/or insulating a suspended ground floor Major k. Removing chimney or providing another means of sealing over chimney, internally or externally Major NOTES: 1. If the energy efficiency works involve only replacing windows, then the guidance in paragraphs 3.14 to 3.16 may be followed as an alternative means of demonstrating compliance. 2. Draught-proofing …"}, {"ref": "Sch 3 para 20", "document": "BR2010", "text": "20. Installation of insulating material to the external and internal walls of a building (“hybrid insulation”), not including insulation of demountable-clad buildings, and not including the installation of flexible thermal linings. | A person registered in respect of that type of work by Blue Flame Certification Limited, British Board of Agrément, CERTASS Limited, Certsure LLP or NAPIT Registration Limited ...."}]}

message.reasoning: This is external wall insulation on a house, which falls under Schedule 3 paragraph 19 as a notifiable renovation of a thermal element covered by a competent person scheme. Since it's a house, fire safety order doesn't apply and proximity to a sewer isn't relevant here, so the right label is competent_person_scheme.
